children: The Board has approved Rangan’s reappointment for a one-year term from 23 November 2026, extending his executive leadership mandate at the bank

HDFC Bank has reappointed V. Srinivasa Rangan as Whole-Time Director, designated as Executive Director, for a one-year term from 23 November 2026 to 22 November 2027. The Board approved the reappointment along with his remuneration, allowing Rangan to continue in the bank’s senior executive leadership during the renewed tenure.
The reappointment will take effect from 23 November 2026 and remain valid until 22 November 2027, according to the terms approved by the Board.
Rangan will continue as Whole-Time Director with the designation of Executive Director during the period. The Board has also approved the remuneration associated with his renewed tenure.
The one-year extension provides continuity at the executive leadership level as HDFC Bank continues to manage its operations, governance responsibilities and longer-term business priorities.
As Executive Director, Rangan remains part of HDFC Bank’s senior management structure and will continue contributing to the bank’s leadership and governance framework.

Whole-time directors typically carry executive responsibilities alongside their position on the Board, connecting operational management with oversight at the board level. Rangan’s continuation therefore maintains an existing leadership arrangement rather than introducing a new executive to the organisation.
The reappointment extends Rangan’s formal executive mandate for another year and keeps him involved in the bank’s governance structure through November 2027.

For large financial institutions, continuity at the executive director level can be significant as banks navigate regulatory requirements, risk management, business expansion and internal governance processes.
The renewed term also ensures continuity in senior decision-making during the specified period, with the terms of appointment and remuneration already approved by the Board.

Rangan’s latest tenure will begin on 23 November 2026 and conclude on 22 November 2027. During this period, he will continue serving as Executive Director under the conditions approved by HDFC Bank’s Board.
The move extends his existing leadership role for a defined period and maintains continuity within the bank’s executive and governance structure.
